nl: How many instances of tools/consumer.py with the argument bench-queue-3 are running right now? Answer with the number.

setup.description: 4 instances of tools/consumer.py bench-queue-3 run in the background.
setup.bash:
setsid python3 tools/consumer.py bench-queue-3 0 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/consumer.py bench-queue-3 1 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/consumer.py bench-queue-3 2 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/consumer.py bench-queue-3 3 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 0.5
setup.pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/consumer.py','bench-queue-3','0'
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/consumer.py','bench-queue-3','1'
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/consumer.py','bench-queue-3','2'
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/consumer.py','bench-queue-3','3'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
